description: Finds the cause of a bug in an Umbraco package or backoffice extension: reproduces it, gathers evidence, and tests one hypothesis at a time until the cause is proven. Never writes the fix; routes it to `quick-fix` or the feature pipeline. Use for "why is this broken", "this stopped working", an unexplained failing test, or an issue triaged as needing investigation. `--unattended` runs without questions in its own worktree.
